passage:
Room 801 had a class calendar on the wall. It showed tests, club days, birthdays, and school events.
At first, only the teacher wrote on it. Then she gave students permission to add important dates. Soon, the calendar became colorful. Students added basketball games, music practice, library days, and reminders to water the class plant.
One student wrote, "Be kind to yourself day" on a Wednesday. No one knew who wrote it, but everyone liked it.
The calendar helped the class remember more than homework. It helped them see that everyone had different things to care about.
By the end of the year, the calendar was full. It looked messy, but it showed the life of the class.
